question: How is interest calculated on this loan?
answer: Interest accrues from the day the loan is advanced (p. 5). The bank calculates interest daily on the principal balance owing by multiplying the outstanding principal balance by a daily interest factor based on the interest rate in effect on that day (p. 5). All daily interest charges are added together for each day in the statement period to determine the total interest accrued in the particular month (p. 5). Interest will be compounded monthly, meaning unpaid interest from the immediately preceding month will be added to the loan balance each month (p. 5). The bank may choose to charge interest on interest (p. 5).

question: What happens if I do not make a payment when it is due?
answer: If you do not pay any amount when due, you will be in default under this Agreement (p. 9).
